name: Nordrassil
summary: Above Mount Hyjal, Nordrassil bears its wounds, and the night elves know age and sickness. Planted over the second Well of Eternity, the World Tree once sheltered its power and gave the kaldorei immortality for ten thousand years. Its sacrifice broke Archimonde’s assault during the Third War.

sections.title: Crown of the Heavens
sections.body:
Nordrassil rose from an acorn of G'Hanir above the new Well of Eternity. Ten thousand years ago, after the Great Sundering, Illidan Stormrage poured vials of the original Well into a lake atop Mount Hyjal. There he made a new font of arcane power.

To keep its magic from corrupting the world or drawing the Burning Legion back, Alexstrasza planted the acorn. Nordrassil’s roots reached deep beneath Azeroth, sealing the Well’s volatile energies and spreading gentle, life-giving vigor across the continents.

sections.title: The Aspects' Gifts
sections.body:
Three Great Dragon Aspects blessed Nordrassil, and the tree became the spiritual and cultural heart of night elf civilization. Alexstrasza filled it with vigor that sustained the kaldorei. Ysera bound its roots to the Emerald Dream, so night elf druids could enter her sleeping realm with effortless clarity.

Nozdormu the Timeless One laid his blessing over its boughs. While the tree stood, the night elves would not age or succumb to natural disease. For ten thousand years, the kaldorei knew immortality.

sections.title: The Fall at Mount Hyjal
sections.body:
During the Third War, Archimonde brought his war to Nordrassil. The demon lord marched on Mount Hyjal to tear apart the tree and seize the Well’s infinite power. As the mortal defenders neared defeat, Malfurion Stormrage sounded the Horn of Cenarius and called thousands of nature spirits. Then he unleashed the enchantments within Nordrassil. The blast destroyed Archimonde and shattered the Legion’s assault.

Nordrassil survived, but its enchantments broke. The night elves lost their immortality, and the wounded tree began a slow healing.

aliases: what does nordrassil mean in darnassian
faq.answer: In Darnassian, Nordrassil means “Crown of the Heavens.” Its great height rises above sacred Mount Hyjal’s summit.

aliases: where is the original world tree
faq.answer: Nordrassil grows at Mount Hyjal’s summit in northern Kalimdor. Its roots reach into the waters of the second Well of Eternity, created by Illidan Stormrage.

faq.q: Why did the night elves lose their immortality?
aliases: why aren't night elves immortal anymore
faq.answer: The night elves lost their immortality when Malfurion Stormrage unleashed Nordrassil’s magic to defeat Archimonde at Mount Hyjal. The blast destroyed the demon lord and broke the Dragon Aspects’ blessings, ending Nozdormu’s spell of eternal life.

faq.q: How is Nordrassil related to Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Nordrassil is the original World Tree atop Mount Hyjal. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and the Circle of the Ancients grew the younger Teldrassil off Kalimdor’s coast in a desperate bid to replace Nordrassil and reclaim the lost immortality.

faq.q: Did Nordrassil die when Archimonde was defeated?
faq.answer: Nordrassil survived Archimonde’s defeat. The blast scorched and wounded the tree, but its roots endured. It remains atop Mount Hyjal, slowly mending, though its ancient dragon blessings are gone.

Three Dragon Aspects blessed Nordrassil. Alexstrasza the Life-Binder planted it and gave it vitality, Ysera the Dreamer bound it to the Emerald Dream, and Nozdormu the Timeless One granted the night elves eternal youth.

angles.text: Nordrassil cradled your civilization for ten thousand years. Its sacrifice saved the world from Archimonde, but now you face aging, sickness, and mortality for the first time.
Nordrassil’s bond with Ysera let druids cross into the Emerald Dream with ease. Its wounds show the cost of defending nature.
At Mount Hyjal, the Alliance joined a desperate coalition to shield Nordrassil from the Burning Legion and save Kalimdor.
Warchief Thrall led the Horde to Mount Hyjal’s slopes with humans and night elves. Their stand gave Malfurion time to spring the trap at Nordrassil’s base.
